quests.title: Before They Touch Station Street East
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. They start on Station Street East on Wednesday and the orange fencing goes up. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I want Harris Park on record before it does. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: photograph the state of Station Street East
then the other end of it

quests.title: Bin Night, Hassall Street
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Somebody moves the bins on Hassall Street in front of my drive every Anzac Day night. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Photograph the evidence and have a word; Harris Park knows who. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: photograph the bins at Hassall Street
and the woman who moved them

quests.title: One Stop From Wigram Street
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. I need to know the train from Harris Park stops at Parramatta and doesn't sail through like it did on grand final day. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Ride it at five and photograph the sign. Do not let them talk you into anything.

and photograph the platform sign

quests.title: A Flat White From Wigram Street

quests.title: Race Four, the Harris Park chaat strip
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. There's a horse in race four at closing that a bloke at the Harris Park chaat strip swears by. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in Harris Park and tell me if it came in. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: turn the tip into fifty-five
tell me if it came in

quests.title: Closing Time at Marion Street
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on Marion Street since the pub shut. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. The Harris Park delivery's at the last train, so get them up and show me the step empty. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off Marion Street

quests.title: The Marion Street Lift
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. The lift at Harris Park station has been out since the Easter Show and I'm told Parramatta is worse. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Check both Monday and tell me which takes a pram. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

quests.title: The Robin Thomas Reserve Course
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. A bloke near Robin Thomas Reserve runs a ninety-minute course he bills at four hundred, and I've paid. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Sit it Friday, then come back to Harris Park and prove it did something. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: do the course they run near Robin Thomas Reserve
then show me what it taught you

quests.title: The Length of Robin Thomas Reserve
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. I haven't walked Robin Thomas Reserve end to end since the light rail came to Harris Park. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Do it Easter Saturday for me and photograph what's at the far end now. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.
